acts.desc: Ira Glass introduces producer Chana Joffe-Walt, who reports this week's story.
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: Chana Joffe-Walt tells what happened when a group of public school students in the Bronx went to visit an elite private school three miles away.

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: The kids who traveled three miles up the road are in their mid-20s now. We hear how what they saw affected them for years, including at college. Chana reports.
